text.text: Cisco UCS M4 Blade Servers

graphic.text: Cisco UCS M4 Blade Servers

text.text: VxBlock Systems support Cisco UCS M4 and M5 blade servers. The UCS B-Series Blade Serves incorporate industry-standard server technologies, delivering a unified-architecture-driven solution for data centers. The UCS design reduces complexity, both at hardware and management levels across a distributed compute environment with the Cisco UCS Manager capability. text.text: Cisco UCS Fabric Interconnects

graphic.text: Cisco UCS Fabric Interconnects

text.text: Cisco UCS fabric interconnects (FI) offer line-rate, low-latency, lossless 10 Gigabit Ethernet and Fibre Channel over Ethernet (FCoE) functions. The fabric interconnects provide the management and communication backbone for the blades and chassis, and facilitate LAN and SAN connectivity for all blades within their domain. VxBlock Systems use either Cisco UCS 6248UP fabric interconnects or Cisco UCS 6296UP fabric interconnects. Single domain uplinks of 2, 4, or 8 between the fabric interconnects and the chassis are provided by the Cisco UCS 6248UP fabric interconnects. Single domain uplinks of four to eight between the fabric interconnects and the chassis are provided with the Cisco UCS 6296UP fabric interconnects.

text.text: Cisco UCS Fabric Extenders

graphic.text: Cisco UCS Fabric Extenders

text.text: The VxBlock System 350 supports the Cisco UCS 2204XP and UCS 2208XP and Fabric Extenders. The Fabric Extenders (FEX) within the Cisco UCS chassis connects to Cisco fabric interconnects over converged Ethernet. Up to eight 10 GE ports on each FEX connect northbound to the fabric interconnects regardless of the number of blades in the chassis. These connections carry IP and storage traffic and can be configured as port channels.

Networking:

text.text: Cisco MDS Switch / Director

graphic.text: Cisco MDS Switch / Director

text.text: VxBlock Systems support Cisco MDS 9148S Multilayer Fabric Switch and MDS 9396S and 9706 Multilayer Director. The VxBlock System contain two Cisco MDS switches to provide Fibre Channel (FC) connectivity between the compute and storage layer components. These switches comprise two separate fabrics and do not interconnect. Each connection from the storage components provides 16 Gb of bandwidth. Cisco UCS fabric interconnects provide a FC port channel of four 8 Gb connections (32 Gb bandwidth) to each fabric. This can be increased to eight connections for 64 Gb bandwidth or 16 connections for 128 Gb bandwidth.

text.text: Virtual Networks

graphic.text: Virtual Networks

text.text: The Advanced Management Platform (AMP-2) offers choice in virtual networking with the Nexus 1000V and the VMware Virtual Distributed Switch (VDS). Virtual networking in VxBlock Systems can be managed by the Cisco Nexus 1000V distributed virtual switch or the VMware VDS. The Cisco Nexus 1000V Series Switch ensures consistent, policy-based network capabilities to all servers in the data center by allowing policies to move with a virtual machine during live migration. In addition, VxBlock Systems support VMware NSX.

Storage:

text.text: Dell EMC Unity

graphic.text: Dell EMC Unity

text.text: Dell EMC Unity is an all-flash midrange designed storage array. This dual controller architecture provides an exceptional blend of performance, capacity and simplicity. Although the Unity is an all flash designed storage array, it is also available in hybrid configurations. The VxBlock System 350 is available with the following Unity storage options; the Unity 300F, 400F, 500F and 600F, and the Unity 300, 400, 500, and 600.

text.text: Dell EMC Unity Specifications

graphic.text: Dell EMC Unity Specifications

text.text: Depending on which Unity storage option you go with, the VxBlock System 350 can support up to 1,000 drives or 10 PB’s raw capacity (15 PB effective capacity), up to 512 Gbs of memory and up to 2x Intel 14-core, 2.4GHz CPUs. Unity arrays come standard with all array based software, including Data-at-Rest Encryption, scalable file system, inline compression, unified snapshots/replication, QoS, and IP-based multi-tenancy to name a few. The VxBlock 350 supported Dell EMC Unity 350F, 450F, 550F and 650F all-flash and Dell EMC Unity 300, 400, 500 and 600 hybrid-flash arrays.

Virtualization:
VMware

text.text: VMware vSphere is the virtualization platform that provides the foundation for the private cloud. The core VMware vSphere components are the VMware vSphere Hypervisor ESXi and the VMware vCenter Server for management. The hypervisors are deployed in a cluster configuration and can scale up to 32 nodes per cluster. The cluster allows dynamic allocation of resources, such as CPU, memory, and storage. The cluster also provides workload mobility and flexibility with the use of VMware vMotion and Storage vMotion technology.

text.text: Dell EMC Vision Intelligent Operations Software

graphic.text: Dell EMC Vision Intelligent Operations Software

text.text: Dell EMC Vision Intelligent Operations enables and simplifies converged operations. The software acts as a mediation layer between VxBlock Systems and data center management tools, dynamically informing those tools about VxBlock Systems. It delivers intelligent discovery to provide a single-objective perspective on the Systems. Comprehensive awareness of the industry-leading components that comprise VxBlock Systems promotes infrastructure standardization through automated validation and system assurance. And integration capabilities make it possible to provide this level of intelligence to any toolset. The software has native integration with the VMware® Virtualization and Cloud Management Portfolio, and also supports API-enabled integration into other standard industry tools.
